left to right direction

actor Usuario

rectangle \"Sistema de Gestión de Turnos\" {

 usecase \"Registrarse\" as UC1

 usecase \"Consultar disponibilidad\" as UC3
 usecase \"Reservar turno\" as UC4
 usecase \"Consultar turnos\" as UC5
 usecase \"Cancelar turno\" as UC6
 usecase \"Gestionar personas asociadas\" as UC7

 usecase \"Seleccionar profesional\" as UC8
 usecase \"Seleccionar fecha y horario\" as UC9
 usecase \"Seleccionar turno\" as UC10


 UC3 ..> UC2 : <<include>>

 UC4 ..> UC2 : <<include>>
 UC4 ..> UC8 : <<include>>
 UC4 ..> UC9 : <<include>>

 UC5 ..> UC2 : <<include>>

 UC6 ..> UC2 : <<include>>
 UC6 ..> UC10 : <<include>>

 UC7 ..> UC2 : <<include>>
}


Usuario --> UC1
Usuario --> UC2
Usuario --> UC3
Usuario --> UC4
Usuario --> UC5
Usuario --> UC6
Usuario --> UC7

@enduml",
 "config": null
